sql:
SELECT DISTINCT `employee`.`employee_name` AS `员工姓名`, `employee`.`department_name` AS `部门`
FROM `employee`
INNER JOIN `training_enrollment` ON `employee`.`id` = `training_enrollment`.`employee_id`
ORDER BY `employee`.`department_name`, `employee`.`employee_name`
LIMIT 200
